title_sq: Apartament 1+1 per shitje te United Towers of Tirana
description_sq:
Ofrohet per shitje apartament ne kompleksin e ri te banimit, “United Tower” prane kompleksit Dinamo dhe rruges se Kosovareve. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katet e larta (15) dhe ka pamje te lire nga mali i Dajtit. Orientimi eshte lindje-jug dhe hapesira shtrihet ne nje siperfaqe totale prej 81.1 metrash dhe te te banueshme 64.9. Planimetri e rregullt me nje organizim korridor hyres, tualet, dhome ndenje dhe dhome gjumi me dalje ne ballkon. Ndertimi parashikohet te perfundoje brenda 3 viteve.
-United Tower of Tirana eshte nje godine multifunksionale me 25 kat mbi toke dhe 5 kat nentoke.
E pozicionuar prane liqenit te Tirane me pamje fantastike dhe njesi tregetare me location perfekt.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in United Towers of Tirana
description_en: An apartment is offered for sale in the new residential complex, "United Tower", near the Dinamo complex and Kosovareve Street. The apartment is located on the upper floors (15) and has a clear view of Dajti mountain. The orientation is east-south and the space extends to a total surface of 81.1 meters and habitable 64.9. Regular layout with an entrance hall, toilet, living room and bedroom with access to the balcony. The construction is expected to be completed within 3 years. - United Tower of Tirana is a multifunctional building with 25 floors above ground and 5 floors underground. Positioned near the lake of Tirana with a fantastic view and a commercial unit with a perfect location.
